source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 719 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 719 was established by Ordinance No. 25897, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 23, 2005. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 719 is established on property located on the north side of Forest Lane, between Hillcrest Road and Preston Road. The size of PD 719 is approximately 3.8 acres. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For single family uses and private streets, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 719A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided below, the only main uses permitted in this district are those uses permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-16(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP, and a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-16(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district.

(b) Private streets (permitted by right). (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-16(A) Single Family District apply in this district.

(b) Front yard. For single family uses, minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(c) Side and rear yard.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, for single family uses, minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) For single family uses, minimum setback from the lake is 15 feet for those lots adjacent to the north shore of the lake and 10 feet for those lots adjacent to the south shore of the lake.

(3) For single family uses, a minimum separation of eight feet is required between any two single family structures.

(d) Density. For single family uses, maximum number of dwelling units is 12.

(e) Height. For single family uses, maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. For single family uses, maximum lot coverage is 60 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(g) Lot size. For single family uses, minimum lot size is 6,000 square feet. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) For single family uses and private streets, the requirements for protective fencing and mitigation of tree removal apply in this district. No grading may occur, and no building permit may be issued to authorize work on the Property until any required protective fencing is inspected and approved by the building official or his designated representative.

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.112. FENCES.

(a) For single family uses, a maximum nine-foot-high fence is permitted in the front yard in the locations shown on the development plan.

(b) For single family uses, screening must be provided as shown on the development plan. Solid screening adjacent to the lake must terminate at the side and/or rear building line for the lot adjacent to the lake. Open wrought iron fences are allowed within the rear setback area for those lots adjacent to the lake, but the fences must terminate at least 10 feet from the lake water level. Solid screening is allowed in all other areas not adjacent to the lake. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance for that use with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) Sidewalks in this district are not required, however, if sidewalks are constructed, they must comply with the provisions in Section 51A-8.606.

(d) Impermeable surfaces are prohibited within 10 feet of the lake, except as needed for the construction of a retaining wall necessary to prevent erosion.

(e) No ingress or egress is permitted to or from Forest Lakes Lane.

(f) In the area shown on the development plan, the screening wall must be finished with the same materials on both sides of the wall. (Ord. 25897)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-719.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 719 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25897)
